narrative.northStar: The Campaign Poster, Set to Work
narrative.overview:
The Editor takes a poster-scale brand language — red, ink, white content bands, uppercase weight-800 display type, and pill controls — and turns it into a dense working surface for cataloguing banknotes. The poster voice appears where the app speaks to the user (screen titles, eyebrows, primary actions) and then gives way to white data bands, hairline grids, and quiet grey chrome.

Three materials carry the system: ink (#25282b) as the navigation rail and overlay world, white (#ffffff) as the content and table surface, and brand red (#e60000) as the single accent. Red never becomes a background wash on the page; it marks the primary action, the active navigation edge, selection, focus, and the tags that need attention.

Structure stays dense and quiet. The Table screen is the centre of gravity: one bordered white card filling the viewport, a fixed 64px ink rail that expands on hover, compact 40px headers, and 12px cell padding tuned for scanning hundreds of rows.
keyCharacteristics: One accent: Brand Red (#e60000), used for the primary pill, active edges, focus, selection, and tags.
Two-band polarity: ink navigation and overlays against white content; no warm greys or second accent hue.
Uppercase weight-800 display type with tight tracking for screen titles and eyebrows.
Pill geometry on every interactive control; cards and inputs stay at the brand's 6px.
Flat cards at rest; shadows only for floating chrome.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is state and action, never decoration. It covers at most about a tenth of any screen, which is what makes the primary pill and the active edge read instantly.

rules.name: The White Room Rule
rules.body: Content lives on white or on a grey step of the same neutral family. No warm cream, blue-grey, or second tinted neutral enters the page.

rules.name: The Shout Then Speak Rule
rules.body: Screen titles and eyebrows shout — uppercase, weight 800, tight tracking. Supporting headings and running copy speak in sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes in place is set in tabular-nums so it never jitters.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat. A shadow is earned by openness or floating above the page, never used as decoration.

dos: Reserve Brand Red for the primary pill, the active navigation edge, focus, selection, and the tag family.
Set screen titles and eyebrows in uppercase weight 800 with tight tracking.
Use pills for every interactive control and 6px corners for cards, inputs, and panels.
Cycle the page: ink rail and overlays, white content, grey chrome.
Keep the Table compact and let Showcases be the looser surface.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or glassmorphism.
Don't paint large red fills behind content.
Don't use soft drop shadows on flat cards at rest.
Don't set body copy in uppercase or weight 800.
Don't turn the sidebar into a drawer or let it push the main column.
